# Current CMake/toolchain adapter; upstream DSP source remains unmodified.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
include(CheckSymbolExists)
include(CheckCCompilerFlag)
set(soxr_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../soxr")
set(WITH_CR64 1)
set(WITH_CR64S 0)
set(WITH_HI_PREC_CLOCK 1)
check_symbol_exists(lrint "math.h" HAVE_LRINT)
set(HAVE_FENV_H 1)
set(HAVE_STDBOOL_H 1)
set(HAVE_STDINT_H 1)
if(CMAKE_C_BYTE_ORDER STREQUAL "BIG_ENDIAN")
  set(HAVE_BIGENDIAN 1)
endif()
set(soxr_sources soxr.c data-io.c dbesi0.c filter.c fft4g64.c cr.c cr64.c)
# Only these translation units require AVX. soxr.c checks CPU and OS support
# at runtime and selects the scalar Float64 path on older processors.
if(MSVC AND CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID MATCHES "^(X86|x64)$")
  set(soxr_avx_flag /arch:AVX)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|i[3-6]86)$")
  check_c_compiler_flag(-mavx soxr_has_avx)
  if(soxr_has_avx)
    set(soxr_avx_flag -mavx)
  endif()
endif()
if(soxr_avx_flag)
  set(WITH_CR64S 1)
  list(APPEND soxr_sources cr64s.c pffft64s.c util64s.c)
  foreach(source cr64s.c pffft64s.c util64s.c)
    set_source_files_properties("${soxr_source}/src/${source}" PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${soxr_avx_flag}")
  endforeach()
endif()
configure_file("${soxr_source}/soxr-config.h.in" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/soxr-config.h")
list(TRANSFORM soxr_sources PREPEND "${soxr_source}/src/")
add_library(are_soxr STATIC ${soxr_sources})
set_target_properties(are_soxr PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
target_include_directories(are_soxr SYSTEM PUBLIC "${soxr_source}/src" PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(are_soxr PRIVATE SOXR_LIB _USE_MATH_DEFINES _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
if(MSVC)
  # MSVC ignores upstream's STDC FENV_ACCESS pragmas; this build uses Float64 I/O.
  target_compile_options(are_soxr PRIVATE /utf-8 /guard:cf /fp:precise /wd4068)
elseif(UNIX)
  target_link_libraries(are_soxr PRIVATE m)
endif()
